Name: 103_ethanol_alcohol_pacap_alcoholic
Representative_Docs: ['SAMe depletion occurs already after 8 weeks of alcohol feeding and is fully corrected by PPC, in parallel with the prevention by PPC of the alcohol-induced oxidative stress. Name: 104_dhea_myostatin_insulin_levels
Representative_Docs: ['Muscle-specific myostatin expression is not increased under catabolic conditions in insulin-deprived diabetes. Name: 105_tsh_thyroid_hypothyroidism_hyperthyroidism

Name: 106_complement_grzb_odn_immune

Name: 107_ptsd_stress_trauma_childhood

Name: 108_peritoneal_peritonitis_pd_intraperitoneal

Name: 109_heat_exercise_temperature_performance
Representative_Docs: ['These results suggest that prior warming by both active and, to a greater extent, passive warming, may predispose a person to greater heat loss and to experience a larger decline in core temperature when subsequently exposed to cold water. Name: 110_ra_joint_mri_remission

Name: 111_resveratrol_quercetin_metabolites_islet

Name: 112_anastomotic_leakage_anastomosis_trpa1

Name: 113_resection_melanoma_hepatectomy_liver

Name: 114_alerts_dnr_cdss_ed

Name: 115_aki_fluid_catecholamine_septic

Name: 116_femoral_screw_fractures_pedicle
Representative_Docs: ['These data suggest this modular femoral stem can provide long-term survivorship with no cases of aseptic loosening at 15 to 20 years after primary THA.
